title: Hold and switch on your phone

steps.text: Hold the phone in your hand. The screen faces you.
steps.alt: A hand holding a black smartphone with the screen facing the person.

steps.text: Find the small button on the right side of the phone.
steps.alt: The right side of a phone, with the power button circled.

steps.text: Press and hold that button for three seconds.
steps.alt: A finger pressing the power button on the side of a phone.

steps.text: The screen lights up. You have switched it on.
steps.alt: A phone screen lit up with the home screen showing.

selfCheck: Did your screen light up? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Charge your phone

steps.text: Find the small charging hole at the bottom of the phone.
steps.alt: The bottom edge of a phone showing the charging port.

steps.text: Put the charger inside. Push gently, never force it.
steps.alt: A charger being placed into the charging port.

steps.text: You will see a battery picture. Leave it to charge.
steps.alt: A phone screen showing a battery charging symbol.

selfCheck: Is your phone charging now? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Touch the screen

steps.text: Your phone listens to your finger. Touch gently.
steps.alt: A finger gently touching a phone screen.

steps.text: Tap once to open something. Tap means touch and lift.
steps.alt: A hand tapping an app picture once.

steps.text: If you touch the wrong thing, press Back. Nothing is broken.
steps.alt: A phone screen with the Back button at the bottom.

steps.text: You can try again as many times as you like.
steps.alt: A calm phone screen with a friendly check mark.

selfCheck: Did you tap and open something? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Volume and silent

steps.text: The volume buttons are on the side of the phone.
steps.alt: Two small volume buttons on the side of a phone.

steps.text: Press the top button to make the sound louder.
steps.alt: A finger pressing the top volume button.

steps.text: Press the bottom button to make it quieter.
steps.alt: A finger pressing the lower volume button.

selfCheck: Did the sound change? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Wi-Fi and mobile data

steps.text: Wi-Fi is internet from a router at home or in a shop.
steps.alt: A small home router with signal waves.

steps.text: Mobile data is internet from your network. It uses airtime.
steps.alt: A phone showing mobile data and airtime.

steps.text: Open Settings, then Wi-Fi, to join a network.
steps.alt: A phone Settings screen with Wi-Fi highlighted.

steps.text: Ask for the Wi-Fi password before you join.
steps.alt: A shopkeeper sharing a Wi-Fi password with a customer.

selfCheck: Do you know the difference now? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Text size and brightness

steps.text: Open Settings. Find Display.
steps.alt: A phone Settings screen with Display highlighted.

steps.text: Choose Text size. Make the words bigger if you like.
steps.alt: A phone showing large text on the screen.

steps.text: Choose Brightness. Make the screen easy for your eyes.
steps.alt: A brightness slider on a phone screen.

selfCheck: Are the words easier to read? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Open and close apps

steps.text: Apps are the small pictures on your screen.
steps.alt: A phone home screen with rows of app pictures.

steps.text: Tap a picture once to open the app.
steps.alt: A finger tapping an app picture.

steps.text: To close it, press the square button, then Close.
steps.alt: The recent apps screen with a Close all button.

selfCheck: Did you open and close an app? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Make a phone call

steps.text: Find the green phone picture. This is for calls.

texts.pcm: Find di green phone picture. Na for call.

steps.alt: A green phone app picture on a phone screen.

steps.text: Press the green phone with your finger.

texts.pcm: Press di green phone with your finger.

steps.alt: A finger pressing the green phone app.

steps.text: You will see numbers. Press the numbers of the person you want to call.

texts.pcm: You go see numbers. Press di numbers of di person you want call.

steps.alt: A phone dialer with large number buttons.

steps.text: Now press the green call button.

texts.pcm: Now press di green call button.

steps.alt: A green call button below the dialed number.

steps.text: When you finish, press the red button to end the call.

texts.pcm: When you finish, press di red button to end di call.

steps.alt: A red end-call button on the call screen.

practice.instruction: Press the green call button to make the call.

selfCheck: Did you make a practice call? Press Yes, or Try again.

checkTexts.pcm: You make one practice call? Press Yes or Try again.

title: Answer and end a call

steps.text: When someone calls, you see a green button and a red button.
steps.alt: An incoming call screen with green answer and red decline buttons.

steps.text: Press the green button to answer.
steps.alt: A finger pressing the green answer button.

steps.text: Press the red button to end the call.
steps.alt: A finger pressing the red end-call button.

selfCheck: Did you answer and end a call? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Save a contact

steps.text: After a call, open your Phone app.
steps.alt: The Phone app open on a recent calls list.

steps.text: Find the number you called.
steps.alt: A recent call number shown in the list.

steps.text: Press Add to contacts. Type the person's name.
steps.alt: An Add to contacts screen with a name field.

steps.text: Press Save. The name will show next time.
steps.alt: A Save button on the contact screen.

selfCheck: Did you save a name? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Make a video call

steps.text: Open WhatsApp and open the chat of the person.
steps.alt: A WhatsApp chat with a family member.

steps.text: Press the small camera picture at the top.
steps.alt: A video camera icon at the top of a WhatsApp chat.

steps.text: Wait for the person to answer. Press red to stop.
steps.alt: A video call screen with a red end button.

selfCheck: Did you start a video call? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Send a voice note on WhatsApp

steps.text: Open WhatsApp. Find the green picture with a phone.

texts.pcm: Open WhatsApp. Find di green picture wey get phone.

steps.alt: The WhatsApp app picture on a phone screen.

steps.text: Press the name of the person you want to talk to.

texts.pcm: Press di name of di person you want talk to.

steps.alt: A WhatsApp chat list with names.

steps.text: Find the small microphone picture at the bottom.

texts.pcm: Find di small microphone picture down.

steps.alt: A microphone icon at the bottom of a WhatsApp chat.

steps.text: Press and hold the microphone with your finger. Speak. Lift your finger to send.

texts.pcm: Press and hold di microphone with your finger. Talk. Lift your finger to send.

steps.alt: A finger holding the microphone button while speaking.

practice.instruction: Hold the microphone for two seconds, then lift your finger.

steps.text: Well done! Your message is sent.

texts.pcm: Well done! Your message don send.

steps.alt: A sent voice note with a play button in the chat.

selfCheck: Did you send the voice note? Press Yes, or Try again.

checkTexts.pcm: You send di voice note? Press Yes or Try again.

title: Take and send a photo

steps.text: Open WhatsApp and open the chat.
steps.alt: A WhatsApp chat screen.

steps.text: Press the small paperclip picture.
steps.alt: A paperclip attachment icon in WhatsApp.

steps.text: Choose Camera. Point at what you want to show.
steps.alt: A camera viewfinder on a phone.

steps.text: Press the white circle to take the picture, then Send.
steps.alt: A white shutter circle and a send button.

selfCheck: Did you take and send a photo? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Open WhatsApp

steps.text: Look for the green picture with a white phone inside.
steps.alt: The green WhatsApp app picture.

steps.text: Tap it once. WhatsApp will open.
steps.alt: A finger tapping the WhatsApp app.

steps.text: You will see your chats. That means it is ready.
steps.alt: The WhatsApp chats list.

selfCheck: Did WhatsApp open? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Open a chat

steps.text: In WhatsApp, you will see names of people.
steps.alt: A list of names in WhatsApp chats.

steps.text: Tap the name of the person you want to talk to.
steps.alt: A finger tapping a name in the chat list.

steps.text: The chat opens. You can now send a message.
steps.alt: An open WhatsApp chat with Ada.

selfCheck: Did the chat open? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Send a message

steps.text: Open the chat of the person.
steps.alt: A WhatsApp chat with a message box at the bottom.

steps.text: Tap the box that says Type a message.
steps.alt: A message box with Type a message written inside.

steps.text: Type your message, or press the microphone to speak.
steps.alt: A phone keyboard and a microphone icon.

steps.text: Press the green send button.
steps.alt: A green send button in WhatsApp.

selfCheck: Did your message send? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Send a photo on WhatsApp

steps.text: Open the chat. Press the paperclip.
steps.alt: A paperclip icon at the bottom of a chat.

steps.text: Choose Gallery to pick a photo.
steps.alt: A menu with Gallery and Camera choices.

steps.text: Tap the photo you want.
steps.alt: A gallery grid of photos.

steps.text: Press Send.
steps.alt: A green Send button on the photo preview.

practice.instruction: Press the paperclip to attach a photo.

selfCheck: Did the photo send? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Join a family group

steps.text: Someone in your family will send you an invite link.
steps.alt: A WhatsApp message with a group invite link.

steps.text: Tap the link. WhatsApp will ask to join the group.
steps.alt: A WhatsApp join group screen.

steps.text: Press Join. You will see the group in your chats.
steps.alt: A Join button and a family group in the chat list.

steps.text: To leave, open the group, press the name, then Exit group.
steps.alt: A group info screen with Exit group at the bottom.

selfCheck: Did you join the group? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: What blue ticks mean

steps.text: One grey tick means your message was sent.
steps.alt: A message with one grey tick.

steps.text: Two grey ticks mean it reached the person's phone.
steps.alt: A message with two grey ticks.

steps.text: Two blue ticks mean the person opened and read it.
steps.alt: A message with two blue ticks.

selfCheck: Do you know what the ticks mean? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: What is a banking app?

steps.text: A banking app is a program that shows your money.
steps.alt: A bank app showing a balance on a phone.

steps.text: You open it with your secret PIN or fingerprint.
steps.alt: A bank app PIN screen.

steps.text: You can check your balance and send money.
steps.alt: A bank app menu with Balance and Transfer.

steps.text: Only open the app your bank told you to use.
steps.alt: A phone home screen with the official bank app.

selfCheck: Do you know what a banking app is? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Check your balance

steps.text: Open your bank app. Never use a link from a message.
steps.alt: A bank app icon on a phone home screen.

steps.text: Enter your PIN on the app's own keypad.
steps.alt: A bank app keypad for entering a PIN.

steps.text: Press Balance or Account.
steps.alt: A bank app menu with Balance highlighted.

practice.instruction: Press Balance to see the practice balance.

steps.text: Read your balance. Then press Log out.
steps.alt: A bank app balance screen with a Log out button.

selfCheck: Did you check the practice balance? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Send money safely

steps.text: Open your bank app and log in with your PIN.
steps.alt: A bank app login screen.

steps.text: Press Transfer or Send money.
steps.alt: A bank app menu with Transfer highlighted.

steps.text: Type the account number and the amount. Check the name.
steps.alt: A transfer form with account number, amount and name.

practice.instruction: Press Transfer to start a practice transfer.

steps.text: Press Send, then confirm with your PIN.
steps.alt: A confirm transfer screen asking for a PIN.

steps.text: Keep the receipt. Never send money to a stranger.
steps.alt: A transfer receipt on a phone.

selfCheck: Did you finish the practice transfer? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: What is a USSD code?

steps.text: USSD is a short code like *123# that works without data.
steps.alt: A phone screen showing a USSD code.

steps.text: Open your Phone app and type the code.
steps.alt: A phone dialer with a USSD code typed in.

practice.instruction: Press the USSD shortcut to try a practice code.

steps.text: Press call. Follow the words on the screen.
steps.alt: A USSD menu with numbered choices.

selfCheck: Do you understand USSD codes? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: POS and bank alerts

steps.text: A POS is a small machine a shop uses to collect money.
steps.alt: A POS machine on a shop counter.

steps.text: After you pay, you get an alert from your bank.
steps.alt: A bank alert on a phone screen.

steps.text: Read the alert. Check the amount and the shop name.
steps.alt: A bank alert showing the amount and the shop.

steps.text: If the alert is wrong, call your bank on the number on your card.
steps.alt: A bank card showing the phone number on the back.

selfCheck: Do you know how to check an alert? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Never share your PIN or OTP

steps.text: Your PIN is your secret. It opens your money.
steps.alt: A lock symbol over a bank card.

steps.text: No bank staff will ever ask for your PIN or OTP.
steps.alt: A bank staff member behind a counter with a crossed-out PIN.

steps.text: Do not write your PIN where people can see it.
steps.alt: A phone with a hidden PIN, not written on paper.

steps.text: Do not tell anyone your OTP, even if they say they are from the bank.
steps.alt: An OTP message with a warning not to share it.

steps.text: If someone asks, stop and call your bank.
steps.alt: A person calling the bank on a phone.

selfCheck: Will you keep your PIN secret? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: What to do if you were scammed

steps.text: If you sent money to a scammer, do not send more.
steps.alt: A hand stopping a money transfer.

steps.text: Call your bank now using the number on the back of your card.
steps.alt: The phone number printed on the back of a bank card.

steps.text: Tell a family member you trust.
steps.alt: A family member comforting an older person.

steps.text: You can also report to the police. Keep the messages.
steps.alt: A phone showing saved scam messages.

selfCheck: Do you know who to call? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: A message asks for your PIN

titleTexts.pcm: One message ask for your PIN

steps.text: Your phone shows a message: 'Your account will be closed. Send your PIN now.'

texts.pcm: Your phone show message: 'Your account go close. Send your PIN now.'

steps.alt: A text message saying the account will be closed and asking for a PIN.

steps.text: Stop. Do not reply.
steps.alt: A large Stop sign.

steps.text: Banks never ask for your PIN in a message or call.

texts.pcm: Bank no dey ever ask for your PIN inside message or call.

steps.alt: A bank building with a crossed-out PIN.

steps.text: Do not press any link.
steps.alt: A link in a message with a warning sign.

steps.text: Tell a family member or call the number on the back of your bank card.

texts.pcm: Tell your family or call di number wey dey back of your bank card.

steps.alt: An older person calling a family member for help.

selfCheck: What should you do? Do not reply, and ask for help. Press Yes, or Try again.

checkTexts.pcm: Wetin you suppose do? No reply. Ask for help.

title: You won a prize?

steps.text: A message says you won a prize you did not enter for.
steps.alt: A message saying Congratulations, you won.

steps.text: Real prizes do not ask you to pay a fee first.
steps.alt: A prize with a crossed-out fee.

steps.text: Do not press the link or send money.
steps.alt: A finger moving away from a link.

steps.text: Delete the message and tell a family member.
steps.alt: A message being deleted.

selfCheck: Will you ignore prize messages? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: SIM swap

steps.text: Your phone suddenly has no network for a long time.
steps.alt: A phone showing no network signal.

steps.text: Someone may have copied your SIM card.
steps.alt: Two SIM cards, one being taken away.

steps.text: Go to your network shop with your ID.
steps.alt: A network shop counter.

steps.text: Call your bank and ask them to protect your account.
steps.alt: A person calling their bank.

selfCheck: Do you know what to do? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: A relative in trouble

steps.text: You get a call from a new number: 'I am in trouble, send money.'
steps.alt: A phone call from an unknown number.

steps.text: Scammers can pretend to be your child.
steps.alt: A person wearing a mask while on the phone.

steps.text: Hang up and call your child on their old number.
steps.alt: A person hanging up and dialing a saved number.

steps.text: Ask a question only your family would know.
steps.alt: A family member answering a private question.

selfCheck: Will you hang up and check first? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Fake job or loan offers

steps.text: A job or loan that asks you to pay first is dangerous.
steps.alt: A job advert with a warning sign.

steps.text: Real employers do not ask for money to give you work.
steps.alt: A real office with a handshake.

steps.text: Do not send your BVN or card details.
steps.alt: A BVN number with a crossed-out eye.

steps.text: Check with someone you trust before you pay.
steps.alt: Two people talking over a phone.

selfCheck: Will you check before paying? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Unknown links

steps.text: A link is a word or picture you can press to open a page.
steps.alt: A blue link inside a message.

steps.text: Do not press links from people you do not know.
steps.alt: A link with a warning sign.

steps.text: If you are not sure, delete the message.
steps.alt: A message being deleted.

selfCheck: Will you avoid strange links? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Block and report a scammer

steps.text: Open the message from the sender.
steps.alt: A text message open on a phone.

steps.text: Press the sender's name or number.
steps.alt: The sender's number at the top of a message.

steps.text: Choose Block, then Delete.
steps.alt: A menu with Block and Delete.

practice.instruction: Open the scam message and press Block.

selfCheck: Did you block the sender? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Who to call for help

steps.text: Call your bank on the number on the back of your card.
steps.alt: The phone number on the back of a bank card.

steps.text: Tell your facilitator or a family member.
steps.alt: A facilitator helping an older learner.

steps.text: You can press Talk to a person in this app.
steps.alt: A Talk to a person button on a phone.

selfCheck: Do you know who to call? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Find information on the internet

steps.text: Open your browser, the app with a globe picture.
steps.alt: A browser app with a globe icon.

steps.text: Tap the search box and type what you want to know.
steps.alt: A search box with a question typed in.

steps.text: Read the first answers, but check who wrote them.
steps.alt: Search results with website names.

selfCheck: Did you search for something? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Play music and radio

steps.text: Open a music app like YouTube or a radio app.
steps.alt: A music app with a play button.

steps.text: Tap the play button to start. Tap pause to stop.
steps.alt: Play and pause buttons on a music player.

steps.text: Use the volume buttons on the side of your phone.
steps.alt: Volume buttons on the side of a phone.

selfCheck: Did you play some music? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Read the news

steps.text: Open your browser and search for news.
steps.alt: A browser search for news.

steps.text: Tap a story from a name you know.
steps.alt: News stories with website names.

steps.text: Be careful with stories that ask for money or your PIN.
steps.alt: A news story with a warning sign.

selfCheck: Did you read a news story? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Book a ride

steps.text: Open a ride app like Bolt or Uber.
steps.alt: A ride app with a map.

steps.text: Type where you are going. Check the price before you book.
steps.alt: A ride app destination box and price.

steps.text: Check the driver's name and plate number.
steps.alt: A driver profile with name and plate number.

steps.text: Share your trip with a family member.
steps.alt: A share trip button on a ride app.

selfCheck: Do you know how to book safely? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Book a clinic appointment

steps.text: Call your clinic or open their website.
steps.alt: A clinic reception desk and a phone.

steps.text: Say your name and the day you want to come.
steps.alt: A person speaking to a clinic receptionist.

steps.text: Write the date where you can see it.
steps.alt: A calendar with an appointment date circled.

selfCheck: Did you book a practice appointment? Press Yes, or Try again.

title: Government websites

steps.text: Government websites end with .gov.ng.
steps.alt: A browser address bar showing a .gov.ng address.

steps.text: Do not use a link from a stranger to do NIN or pension.
steps.alt: A link from a stranger with a warning sign.

steps.text: Type the address yourself in your browser.
steps.alt: A person typing a web address.

steps.text: Ask a facilitator if you are not sure.
steps.alt: A facilitator helping with a phone.

selfCheck: Do you know a safe government address? Press Yes, or Try again.
